name: XUI
author: rajok
status: Rootless tested; rootful device test pending.
description:
iPhone X gestures, a home indicator, floating dock, native flashlight and camera buttons on the Lock Screen, and adjustable app/keyboard spacing. Russian and English Settings. Stock iPhone 8 status bar.

Supports iPhone 8 (iPhone10,1 / iPhone10,4), iOS 16. Rootless tested on iOS 16.7.16. Rootful build awaits device testing. LiquidAss is optional and is not included.

Жесты iPhone X, нижняя полоса, плавающий док, нативные кнопки фонарика и камеры, настраиваемые отступы приложений и клавиатуры. Настройки на русском и английском.

name: iOS26Anim
author: Stealth2115
status: Built for ARM64 iPhone 8; device testing pending.
description:
iOS 26-style app opening and closing animations for iPhone 8 on iOS 16. Upstream source by Stealth2115; rootless and rootful packages built by rajok. The original animation code and tuning are preserved. This is an approximation of iOS 26 animations, not its Metal rendering.

Upstream tuning: 1.50-second opening/closing duration, spring response 0.90, damping 0.60 and blur alpha 0.95. No Settings pane; tuning requires rebuilding.

Анимации открытия и закрытия приложений в стиле iOS 26. Сборки rootless и rootful для iPhone 8 на iOS 16. Автор исходников — Stealth2115, сборка пакетов — rajok. На устройстве пока не проверено.
